Re-reviewed the #3158 DelegationResultDelivery paragraph against 9784c70249. 'An interrupt the service reports stopped nothing (no-active-turn) undoes only its own records' matches the route calling DelegationResultDelivery.settleCancellation with interruptDelegatedTask's interruptOutcome, which calls reopenCancellation (refuseCancel) only for no-active-turn, the outcome CooperativeStop.interruptUserTurnCooperatively and the dormant branch of OrchestrationService's interruptTurn return when nothing runs or the requested turnId is not the interruptible turn. 'until a completion, abort or Session exit on the child's Session' matches onFoldEvent dropping waiting suppressions for turn.completed, turn.aborted and session.exited on the child's current Session (PENDING_INTERRUPT_TERMINALS), as applyPendingTurnInterrupt clears its pending cancel. 'A transition found after a restart never takes a suppression made since' matches record() with caughtUp binding and dropping only suppressions created before the store opened, used by every evaluation that is not the live one. The integration-test sentence matches realServiceInterrupt in the integration test. The paragraph's other clauses are untouched by this change.
